cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says SIGOMAP runs to award or payment or is required of all public bodies: the 2024 extension covers the ministries' contracting authorities (CIV-003). No figure for tenders or value through it has been found.
cells.note: The finance ministry called SIGOMAP, its dematerialised contract-award application, the sole platform for managing public procurement at the end of 2023 (CIV-002). The extension to ministries in 2024 (CIV-003) is not all public bodies, so not stage 4.
